answer_1.quote: This work investigates the influence of annotation settings on annotator behavior and results by using Chinese to English (ZhEn) and English to German (EnDe) machine translation (MT) as a case study.

answer_2.quote: For quality similarity, XCOMET-QE-Ensemble (XCOMET)  is used in tandem with a random permutation test.

answer_4.quote: The annotation experiments are conducted by professional translators who regularly perform MQM annotation.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators see one translation at a time and identify errors with category and severity assignment of each, or see two translations and decide which one is better, without error annotation.
